description: This source file implements cryptographic functions related to Curve25519 and SPAKE2 protocol, including precomputed points, key generation, message creation, and processing functions.

methods.name: SPAKE2_CTX_new
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new SPAKE2 context with specified role and participant names.

methods.name: SPAKE2_CTX_free
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with a SPAKE2 context.

methods.name: SPAKE2_generate_msg
methods.description: Generates a SPAKE2 message based on the context and password, producing a public message and updating the context state.

methods.name: SPAKE2_process_msg
methods.description: Processes a received SPAKE2 message to derive a shared key, updating the context state.
